content: परोक्ष {%a.%} .²1 Out of or beyond the range of sight, invisible, escaping observation. .²2 Absent; स्थाने वृता भूपतिभिः परोक्षैः <ls>R. 7. 13</ls>. .²3 Secret, unknown, stranger; परोक्षमन्मथो जनः <ls>Ś. 2. 19</ls>; ‘a stranger to the influence of love’; परोक्षार्थस्य दर्शकम् <ls>H. Pr. 10</ls>. .{@-क्षः@} An ascetic. .{@-क्षम्@} .²1 Absence, invisibility. .²2 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) Past time or tense (not witnessed by the speaker); परोक्षे लिट् <ls>P. III. 2. 115</ls>. {%Note%}:-- The <ab>acc.</ab> and <ab>loc.</ab> singulars of परोक्ष ({%<ab>i. e.</ab>%} परोक्षं, परोक्षे) are used adverbially in the sense of ‘in oneʼs absence’, ‘out of sight’, ‘behind oneʼs back’, with or without a <ab>gen.</ab>:-- परोक्षे च खलीकर्तुं शक्यते न ममाग्रतः <ls>Mk. 2</ls>; परोक्षे कार्यहन्तारं प्रत्यक्षे प्रियवादिनम् (त्यजेत्) <ls>Chāṇ. 18</ls>; नोदाहरेदस्य नाम परोक्षमपि केवलम् <ls>Ms. 2. 119</ls>.
